### Added
- **Claude Opus 5.5 is priced in the LLM routing catalog: `llmRouting.modelCatalog.providers.anthropic.models.claude-opus-5-5`** (giantswarm/giantswarm-configs#885). Input $4, output $20, cache reads $0.20 and 5-minute cache writes $5 per million tokens, from Anthropic's pricing page. Without the entry, every lookup for the model misses and the gateway emits no cost sample for its calls. Both charts carry it.
